Locked-off camera, framing holds. The masked man leans toward the lens and wags his raised gloved finger side to side in a slow telling-off, four times, his head nodding on the beat; his other hand stays on his hip. Far behind him, the banker on the steps clutches his moneybag tighter and stays where he is. The mask stays exactly as it is. SFX: a gentle breeze. Ambient noise: a quiet city square at noon.

Thanks.
